method: Read official category, visually inspected all 17 catalog cards by scrolling, then opened four product pages and inspected their official descriptions and main product photographs.

detailed_review.description: Stackable modular boxes joined with dedicated fittings; solid wood thickness 1.5 cm; optional backs, doors and drawers; can form a room divider.
detailed_review.visual: Different rectangular box sizes in a stepped composition, visible wood and open backs.
detailed_review.transfer: Individual plywood compartments, some closed, united by spherical printed nodes. Riva construction and material do not establish performance of our adaptation.

detailed_review.description: Asymmetric modular sides and shelves, optional backs, flap doors and drawers, optional double-sided composition.
detailed_review.visual: Light wood rectangular outer silhouette, varied compartments and scattered dark closed fronts.
detailed_review.transfer: Primary inspiration for an asymmetric open/closed cabinet, using two columns and three levels as a practical starting composition.

detailed_review.description: David Chipperfield, 2010. Shelves with different depths and asymmetrically positioned dividers; third shelf may function as a desktop. Veneered multilayer version available on request.
detailed_review.visual: Strong horizontal shelves with projecting ends and staggered broad upright panels.
detailed_review.transfer: Emphasize shelf planes and offset dividers; avoid implying a validated cantilever or load capacity.

detailed_review.description: LCM MARIN Design Studio, 2026. Solid wood and plywood, turned cylindrical uprights, open horizontal modules, metal details on upright ends.
detailed_review.visual: Open plywood/wood boxes supported between round vertical posts, with gaps between box levels.
detailed_review.transfer: Round structural elements and visually separate boxes; spherical nodes are our own construction proposal, not a Riva feature.

design_status: Reference research only. Existing sketches and CAD files have not been modified. Current envelope remains W1000 H1200 D350 mm, plywood 15 mm; height not newly confirmed.
